guarded.EN: Heard. That's enough talk for now.
guarded.TL: Narinig ko. Sapat na ang usapan sa ngayon.
Nakuha ko. Manatili ka sa puwesto mo.

guarded.EN: Got it. Let's keep our heads on our shoulders.
guarded.TL: Naintindihan. Mag-ingat na lang tayo sa paligid.

guarded.EN: I heard what you said. Leaving it at that.
guarded.TL: Narinig ko ang sinabi mo. Iiwan ko na roon.

guarded.EN: I take your point. Let's stay alert.
guarded.TL: Nakuha ko ang punto mo. Manatiling alisto.

guarded.EN: Clear enough. No more discussion needed.
guarded.TL: Malinaw na. Hindi na kailangan ng karagdagang usapan.

guarded.EN: Noted. Back to watching the perimeter.
guarded.TL: Tala ko na. Balik sa pagbabantay.

neutral.EN: All right. Ask if you want to talk more.
neutral.TL: Sige. Magtanong ka kung gusto mo pang mag-usap.

neutral.EN: Understood. Let me know if you need anything else.
neutral.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Sabihan mo ako kung may kailangan ka pa.

neutral.EN: Sounds good. We can pick this up later.
neutral.TL: Mabuti. Pwede nating ipagpatuloy ito mamaya.

neutral.EN: Got it. Let's get back to what we were doing.
neutral.TL: Nakuha ko. Balik na tayo sa ginagawa natin.

neutral.EN: Fair enough. Holler if something comes up.
neutral.TL: Makatwiran. Tawagin mo ako kapag may nangyari.

neutral.EN: All right. We're on the same page.
Got it. I'm around if you need to talk.
neutral.TL: Nakuha ko. Narito lang ako kung kailangan mong makipag-usap.

neutral.EN: Right. We'll leave it there for now.
neutral.TL: Sige. Dito muna tayo magtapos sa ngayon.

warm.EN: All right. I'm here if you want to talk more.
warm.TL: Sige. Narito ako kung gusto mo pang mag-usap.

warm.EN: Glad we talked. Holler anytime you need to chat.
warm.TL: Mabuti at nagkausap tayo. Tawagin mo lang ako kahit kailan.

warm.EN: I hear you loud and clear. Take care of yourself.
warm.TL: Narinig kita nang malinaw. Ingatan mo ang sarili mo.

warm.EN: Good talking with you. We'll catch up again soon.
warm.TL: Masarap kang makausap. Magkuwentuhan ulit tayo mamaya.

warm.EN: Understood. Always good to touch base with you.
warm.TL: Naintindihan ko. Laging magandang makipag-ugnayan sa 'yo.

warm.EN: Anytime you want to talk, you know where to find me.
warm.TL: Kahit kailan mo gustong mag-usap, alam mo kung nasaan ako.

warm.EN: Got it. Stay safe out there today.
warm.TL: Nakuha ko. Mag-ingat ka sa labas ngayong araw.

warm.EN: Always happy to listen. Take it easy.
warm.TL: Lagi akong handang makinig. Dahan-dahan lang.

warm.EN: All right. Glad we got that sorted out together.
warm.TL: Sige. Mabuti at naayos natin 'yan nang magkasama.

warm.EN: Thanks for taking the time to talk. Catch you later.
warm.TL: Salamat sa paglalaan ng oras para mag-usap. Kita tayo mamaya.
